messages:
incident-bot: Pager fired: tenant-prefix-stitching detected for customer cust-171 in dedicated pool-A. severity=high. reason=cache routing anomalies and cross-tenant reads observed. https://infra.redwood/incident/2188882460 :rotating_light:

nina (oncall): confirming alerts. Spike in cache hits where requests from cust-171 returned cache entries with /svc/009/ prefixes. Beginning containment + evidence capture.

amit (sre): assigning runtime eng to validate route tables and check any late-bind or automation changes in the last 48h. @jasper pls confirm host->tenant assignments for pool-A.

jasper (eng-runtime): pulling routing state and cache logs now. quick snapshot: seen x-request-id=2f9a9b... where request path=/svc/171/user/542 but cache key served = /svc/common/user/542 and origin container=c-77a9 (belongs to cust-009). no runtime deploy recorded in last 72h.

lucy (acct-exec): tagging: cust-171 is enterprise, VPC + dedicated GPUs. if we confirm cross-tenant data, we need immediate customer notification and legal loop.

nina (oncall): containment plan: 1) disable writes to shared prefix on pool-A; 2) snapshot kv shards + memcache; 3) pcap uplinks for pool-A; 4) isolate suspect containers for forensics.

security-oliver: agree. preserve chain of custody. do not rotate encryption keys until artifacts captured. add CIRT.

jasper (eng-runtime): looking at route table:
```
route_table[pool-A]:
  cust-009 -> /svc/009/*
  cust-171 -> /svc/171/*
  fallback -> /svc/common/*  # added by automation sync-service-prefixes on 2026-02-15T03:12:03Z
```
That fallback looks dangerous. pulling automation job metadata now.

amit (sre): if automation enabled a permissive fallback, that can cause keyspace collisions for non-namespaced keys. @nina any automation audit info?

nina (oncall): automation-runbot shows job `sync-service-prefixes` set enable_fallback=true at 2026-02-15T03:12:03Z (initiated by deploy-bot). I'm rolling that flag back to false and removing the permissive route from pool-A. will log the rollback event.

customer-ops-sarah: i've opened a secure channel with cust-171 ops lead, asking for any anomalies or captured samples on their side. cc'ing legal.

jasper (eng-runtime): rollback applied. current route table:
```
route_table[pool-A]:
  cust-009 -> /svc/009/*
  cust-171 -> /svc/171/*
  fallback -> OFF
```
I've queued `kv:flush --prefix=/svc/common/` on pool-A to evict possible stale shared entries (conservative). starting cache dump to forensics bucket s3://forensics/2188882460/.

incident-bot: detection-sample: 2026-02-15T03:18:11Z x-request-id=2f9a9b... path=/svc/171/user/542 -> cache-hit key=/svc/common/user/542 returned payload originating from container c-77a9.

security-oliver: treat as potential data exposure. request full payload from cache and backing store for keys in window. capture process list, open files, network connections for c-77a9. tag artifacts.

jasper (eng-runtime): pulled cache dump. sample payloads show profile-like data: name, email, last_active. one sample includes email and hashed phone. storing in forensics. uploading pointers.

nina (oncall): mitigations done: - removed permissive fallback - snapshot kv shards - flushed /svc/common/ cache - isolated container c-77a9 (frozen) - started pcap on pool-A uplinks.

amit (sre): can we run a read-only probe against cust-171 to enumerate keys touched in the window? that would bound exposure.

jasper (eng-runtime): running probe endpoint `_probe/key-list` on pool-A for /svc/171. result: ~1.2k keys with user-* prefix active. cross-checked timestamps and flagged ~14 keys with access in the 03:16-03:22Z window. collecting full list.

customer-ops-sarah: cust-171 confirms they saw mismatched responses ~03:18Z and uploaded 3 sample responses to our secure intake. syncing with forensics.

security-oliver: preliminary look: samples contain email addresses and hashed phones, no SSNs or payment tokens in sampled items. mark as PII exposure; start CIRT escalation and prepare notification templates. legal, advise on disclosure cadence.

legal: received. we need the count of unique impacted users and whether any regulated data types were exposed before we finalize language. recommend provisional notice to customer ops and then user notification based on impact size.

nina (oncall): handoff summary for next oncall (amit): root cause likely permissive fallback route introduced by automation job `sync-service-prefixes` enabling `/svc/common/*` on pool-A, causing cross-tenant cache collisions. containment actions completed. next actions: audit automation runs last 48h for enable_fallback flags, enumerate pools with fallback enabled, run per-pool cache invalidations, identify and evict any containers that served cross-tenant payloads, rotate service tokens for impacted tenants.

amit (sre): taking oncall. i'll run automation audit and escalate to platform. scheduling eviction for containers with confirmed cross-read activity. will coordinate token rotation and customer outreach.

lucy (acct-exec): drafting customer comms. two options: (A) proactive note to cust-171 + cust-009 w/ preliminary facts and mitigation, (B) hold until we have full impact. i recommend A with clear 'investigation ongoing' language.

customer-ops-sarah: agree proactive. sending draft to legal for review, target outbound in ~4h.

security-oliver: evidence checklist: pcap, kv snapshots, container metadata, cross-read payloads, automation job logs. tag artifacts with incident id 2188882460.

jasper (eng-runtime): post-incident action items: - prevent wildcard fallback routes by default - add CI gate to automation preventing enable_fallback=true in prod without explicit reviewer approval - add metric/alert for cross-tenant cache hits and sudden increase in fallback cache hits.

nina (oncall): anyone else to add? otherwise i'll drop from thread and amit will be lead. ack replies only.

amit (sre): ack. i'll post timeline and impact estimate within 2 hours. current customers impacted: cust-171 (confirmed), cust-009 (source), plus exploratory check for other pool-A tenants.

lucy (acct-exec): added AMs for cust-009 and pool-A tenants to outreach list.

incident-bot: Incident state: investigation -> mitigation_in_progress. severity: medium (infra) due to contained customer impact. :white_check_mark:
